name: Shawn Alexander Thompson
bio: Shawn Alexander Thompson was born on November 13, 1970 in Annapolis, Maryland, USA. Currently living in central Florida, Shawn is known for his work on The House That Eats Flesh (2022), Under Three Moons (2022) and Dr. Gift (2022).

credits.overview: July 4th 2015 the world was invaded by zombies. Humanity was put to the test in a small town in Colorado, where it all began.

credits.title: The Present
credits.overview: Time is the ultimate thief...

credits.title: The Legend of Yella George
credits.overview: A man's wife mysteriously goes missing one night. All evidence points towards the husband. As detectives dive deeper into the case, a local legend begins to twist itself into the case, confusing detectives and the husband. Nightmares, death, and mystery surround this story with an ending no one could see coming.

credits.title: Madden
credits.overview: Chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis—from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game.

credits.title: Devour
credits.overview: Stranded after a disastrous gig, an all-girl heavy metal band finds a woman in danger in a town ruled by a warlock, and crawling with cannibals, vampires, and a deadly werewolf, forcing them to fight for survival.

credits.title: Doll of Deceit
credits.overview: A woman's affair with a hired handyman takes a dark turn when her husband discovers the betrayal, leading to a suspenseful tale of captivity and an eerie transformation that blurs the line between reality and nightmare. Who will survive?

credits.title: Joe's College Road Trip
credits.overview: To teach his sheltered grandson about the real world, Madea's foul-mouthed brother Joe takes the college-bound teen on a raucous cross-country road trip.

credits.title: VHS Summer Camp
credits.overview: An independent and original 80s style love letter to the summer camp slashers of the past. When a group of teens are hired to clean up an old summer camp, they soon discover a mysterious VHS tape that reveals glimpses of the future and begin to uncover a dark secret tied to the camps past.

credits.title: Give Me Back My Body!
credits.overview: Jack, a quadriplegic, and Lina, his day nurse, spy on neighbors with a drone and stumble upon a serial killer. When Lina finds a mysterious relic inside the killer's house, it transports her and Jack to an underworld where they switch bodies and are forced to kill for a creature. Embracing the killing inside Lina's bod

credits.title: Blood on the Bleachers
credits.overview: A psychology instructor and her senior class investigate a string of unsolved murders targeting staff and students at their high school over two years, trying to identify the masked killer.

credits.title: Grace by Night
credits.overview: After a tragedy, a man volunteers at a crisis hotline and meets a troubled teen. Together, they pursue hope through a high school wrestling dream.

credits.title: Live Laugh Die
credits.overview: A man going through a series of unfortunate events, while facing his friendly inner demon, will stop at nothing to win his girlfriend back. All while slowly becoming a serial killer.

credits.title: The Inn
credits.overview: Both Guests and Staff at the Palm Court Motel have become prey, after a serial killer checks in for the night.

credits.title: Broken Innocence
credits.overview: When a young girl suffers years of horrendous sexual abuse from her monster of a father, she finally breaks spawning a cold, hateful and manipulative teenager, that will stop at nothing, to get her own way - including murder.

credits.title: Dr. Gift
credits.overview: What do you get when you combine an 80's slasher with a haunting ghost story?

credits.title: Remember Me 2: Forget Me Not
credits.overview: Joe wakes up in hospital and cannot remember who he is. But as the bizarre nightmares continue, he suspects something more evil is taking place.

credits.title: A Wave of Kindness
credits.overview: A young journalist embarks on a quest to find happy stories of resilience and compassion amid his own personal struggles.

credits.title: Not For Sale
credits.overview: NOT FOR SALE is an intense true to life film series starring actor Dean Cain tackling the horrid subject of human trafficking in Florida.

credits.title: Dream Slasher
credits.overview: Amanda is a strong willed "go-getter" who has always been in control, or so she thought...

credits.title: Depravity
credits.overview: Chris and David suffer the loss of their father. But while cleaning the property, they stumble upon a dark secret that leads to revealing truths of the small town. Secrets so dark, they're forced to fight for survival.

credits.title: The Truth About Monsters
credits.overview: A film that targets human trafficking in the unlikeliest place; an exclusive neighborhood, inside a beautiful house. This targets the other side of human trafficking that many may not know about.

credits.title: A Thief's Turmoil
credits.overview: How far is too far when everything you love is on the line?

credits.title: Werewolf Cabal
credits.overview: An American author travels to a small rural town to collect an inheritance left to him by his estranged mother. During his stay, he uncovers a cabal of people who worship Lycanthrope

credits.title: Under Three Moons
credits.overview: Justine travels to Idaho to learn more about her real father. There she meets Matt, a country boy who loves the night sky. Together they search for answers surrounding her father's struggle with dementia and his obsession with aliens.

credits.title: The Club
credits.overview: With a partner on the wrong side of a mass shooting, Theo Abney must overcome his personal rage to see that his boyfriend makes it out alive. An LGBTQ film based on the Pulse Nightclub shooting.

credits.title: The Wendigo
credits.overview: After a social media star disappears in the woods of North Carolina, his friends are set to figure out what happened to him. Ignoring the legend of the cursed land was only their first mistake.

credits.title: Phantom Bride
credits.overview: Jax is ready to take the small town rock band "Phantom Bride" to the next level, but fellow bandmember "Wolf" isn't ready to make the jump, instead comfortable living as the big fish in the small town.  What will happen when bandmembers confront each other about the future of their band.

credits.title: Rose Blood
credits.overview: Takes place 13 months after Friday The 13th Part VII. We follow Tina Shepard as she is held and studied at the infamous Camp Crystal Lake Research Facility. Tina realizes that she is not alone. There in fact is another New Blood. Rose.
